# FG-KNOW-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`knowledge`](../../ops/runbooks/knowledge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `inheritance_not_transitive` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このプロジェクトには Wiki を結び付けられません。
- en: A wiki cannot be linked to this project.
- id: Wiki tidak dapat ditautkan ke proyek ini.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 W1/W2 (ADR-0040 §5): a wiki link (forge.project_wikis) was refused. `reason=already_linked` (the owner project already has a wiki), `reason=wiki_already_linked` (the wiki project is already some project's wiki), `reason=chain` (the owner is itself a wiki, or the wiki already owns a wiki: inheritance is one hop only, enforced by the CHECK `project_wikis_not_self` and the trigger `project_wikis_no_chain`), `reason=self` (a project as its own wiki), `reason=name_taken` (the wiki project's path `<owner>-wiki` or the one asked for is already used in the namespace), `reason=not_linked` (unlinking a project that has no wiki). Not a fault: nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id` (the owner) and, when known, `wiki_project_id`, and the request_id. `SELECT * FROM forge.project_wikis WHERE project_id = <id> OR wiki_project_id = <id>` shows the existing link.

## 対処 (fix)

`already_linked` / `wiki_already_linked`: use the existing wiki, or unlink it first (`gstn wiki unlink`). `name_taken`: choose another path (`gstn wiki create --path <segment>`) or rename the project that holds it. `chain` / `self`: link the wiki to the owner project itself, never to another wiki. See runbook knowledge.
